CommunityApplications.Profile:
Tasqs (tasqs.com) is a task manager with a webhook ingress. This repository holds the Community Applications template for the Tasqs notification agent, which adds a "Tasqs" entry to Settings -> Notifications -> Agents so that unRAID notifications become tasks, and an all-clear completes the task the warning opened.
Source: https://github.com/tasqs-public/unraid-agent
